# Ventra Coffee

> Ventra is Australia's managed coffee partner for the higher education
> sector. Equipment, specialty beans and service under one agreement:
> one partner, no downtime.

## What Ventra does

Ventra provides a fully managed coffee service to Australian higher
education institutions: commercial Swiss-engineered superautomatic machines,
specialty beans from an award-winning, B Corp certified Australian roaster,
milk and consumables, installation, cleaning, preventative maintenance,
fault response, and telemetry-backed monitoring with monthly reporting.
One agreement and one monthly invoice cover all of it.

Every machine carries telemetry, so faults are usually detected and resolved
by Ventra before campus staff notice. Day to day, a nominated "coffee
champion" on campus runs a daily clean and tops up beans and
water between deliveries; everything else is Ventra's responsibility.

## Who it serves

Decision-makers at Australian universities, private higher education
providers and pathway colleges: campus directors, facilities and procurement
leads, and executive teams. Service is designed around the academic
calendar; volumes are forecast on teaching weeks, and maintenance is
scheduled into breaks. The founder spent fifteen years in Australian
international education before starting Ventra.

## How pricing works

A fixed per-site base fee (equipment, service, telemetry, management) plus a
consumption component that scales with cups poured (beans, milk,
consumables). Tailored per institution and presented in full before
signing; no published rate card. Multi-campus agreements run under one
agreement with one invoice.
